name: cinzas-do-olimpo
description: Metroidvania 2D: 36 áreas, 17 chefes, espada e arco.
author: Vinicius Capeto

scripts.prepare-game: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force game | Out-Null; Copy-Item ..\index.html,..\manifest.json,..\icon-192.png,..\icon-512.png game -Force"
scripts.prepare-demo: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force game | Out-Null; Copy-Item ..\demo\index.html,..\demo\manifest.json,..\demo\icon-192.png,..\demo\icon-512.png game -Force"
scripts.build-demo: npm run prepare-demo && electron-builder --win portable -c.productName="Cinzas do Olimpo Demo" -c.directories.output=dist-demo && npm run prepare-game
